// why: This file exists so an editor resolves `from "gpui"` and knows what the
module holds. Without it the imports are opaque and the 700-odd style
`checkJs` is on but `strict` is off on purpose. What is worth catching here
is a misspelled style method, a colour token that does not exist, or a
native module that was never registered — all of which are typed. What is
not worth it is annotating every parameter to satisfy `noImplicitAny`:
this is application code in a scripting layer, and JSDoc on every argument
would cost more to read than it saves. The few annotations that do buy
completion are written where they pay.
